title: HomeFlood Payment Plans, Past-Due Installments and Rescission of a Nonpayment Notice
content:
## Payment plans

The term premium of HomeFlood Private Residential Flood Policies is paid under one of the tier's payment plans.

| Plan | Share collected at the start (down share) | Each later share | Later shares fall due |
|---|---|---|---|
| ANNUAL | 100 percent, with the policy fee | 0 | none |
| semi-annual | 50 percent | 50 percent | 6 calendar months after the term start |
| QUARTERLY | 40 percent | 20 percent each | 3, 6 and 9 calendar months after the term start |

A due date that falls on a day the month lacks moves to that month's last day.

**Fees and rounding clause.** The policy fee is collected in full with the first payment. Each installment after the first carries the tier's installment fee. Every installment is rounded to the cent, and the last installment absorbs the rounding difference.

*Status:* this clause is **no longer in force** for an installment after the first that the policyholder pays themselves under the current installment rule. For every other installment it continues to apply as written.

When the premium is paid by the lender from escrow, the plan is the tier's escrow-billed plan.

## Past-due installments

An installment not received by its due date is past due. Tidemark may then issue a notice of cancellation for nonpayment. The notice's cancellation date is the tier's nonpayment notice period, in calendar days, after the notice date. The notice is also sent to the mortgagee of record.

## Rescission

A notice of cancellation is rescinded only when the full past-due amount is received before the cancellation date stated on the notice, the day itself not qualifying; the policy then continues with no break in coverage. The cancellation date is read from the policy record, and rescission applies to the policy that carries the notice. A payment received on or after the cancellation date does not reinstate the policy; it is applied to any earned premium still owed and the rest is refunded.

| Full past-due amount received | Result |
|---|---|
| the day before the stated cancellation date | notice rescinded, no break in coverage |
| on the stated cancellation date | not rescinded; payment applied to earned premium owed, rest refunded |
| after the stated cancellation date | not rescinded; payment applied to earned premium owed, rest refunded |

The rescission window ends 0 days before the stated cancellation date, so the cancellation date itself is outside it.

*Hypothetical illustration:* on a QUARTERLY plan whose term starts on 30 November, the installment due 3 calendar months later falls on the last day of February.
